size.description:
Metric scale (`--ki-badge-{size}-*` tokens): 20, 24 or 28px tall in
onmars, with 12px text at every size. An unrecognized value falls back to
the `md` metrics the same way.

tone.description:
Semantic intent, never appearance: each tone resolves its colors from
the `--ki-badge-{tone}-*` tokens. An unrecognized value matches no
style selector, so the badge keeps the neutral appearance (fallback by
CSS construction — no validation code).

--ki-badge-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for the neutral badge surface.

--ki-badge-border-width.description: dimension used by the badge component for border width (MarsUI tone tags carry width 0 in default state; only the neutral type draws its 1px edge via ki.badge.neutral.border-width. material3 keeps its border via its override).

--ki-badge-danger-bg.description: color used by the badge component for danger background (MarsUI Surface/danger_base_em_alpha: tone-500 at 12% light — the tint composites over any surface and the dark alias adapts automatically).

--ki-badge-danger-border.description: color used by the badge component for danger border.

--ki-badge-danger-fg.description: color used by the badge component for danger foreground.

--ki-badge-font-family.description: font family used by the badge component for font family.

--ki-badge-font-weight.description: font weight used by the badge component for font weight.

--ki-badge-info-bg.description: color used by the badge component for info background (MarsUI Surface/info_base_em_alpha: tone-500 at 12% light — the tint composites over any surface and the dark alias adapts automatically).

--ki-badge-info-border.description: color used by the badge component for info border.

--ki-badge-info-fg.description: color used by the badge component for info foreground.

--ki-badge-md-font-size.description: dimension used by the badge component for md font size (MarsUI UI/Caption 2: 12px at both sm and md; only xs drops to Caption 1).

--ki-badge-md-height.description: dimension used by the badge component for md height (MarsUI Tag md outer height 28px).

--ki-badge-md-line-height.description: dimension used by the badge component for md line height (MarsUI caption_2 16px).

--ki-badge-md-padding-inline.description: dimension used by the badge component for md padding inline (MarsUI total text inset 10px; paired with the border-width 0 + border-box change so the badge does not shrink).

--ki-badge-md-radius.description: dimension used by the badge component for md radius (MarsUI Tag: Radius/component/radius_sm 8px at both sm and md).

--ki-badge-neutral-bg.description: color used by the badge component for neutral background (MarsUI secondary Tag: Surface/special/secondary_alpha_base, the same fill as ki-button secondary; opaque white in onmars v2, translucent only where a theme turns that back on. material3 keeps the opaque s2 chip via its override).

--ki-badge-neutral-border.description: color used by the badge component for neutral border (MarsUI secondary Tag edge: Outline/secondary_button_top; drawn at ki.badge.neutral.border-width).

--ki-badge-neutral-border-width.description: dimension used by the badge component for the neutral border width: MarsUI draws the 1px edge only on this type.

--ki-badge-neutral-fg.description: color used by the badge component for neutral foreground.

--ki-badge-sm-font-size.description: dimension used by the badge component for sm font size.

--ki-badge-sm-height.description: dimension used by the badge component for sm height.

--ki-badge-sm-line-height.description: dimension used by the badge component for sm line height.

--ki-badge-sm-padding-inline.description: dimension used by the badge component for sm padding inline (MarsUI total text inset 8px; paired with the border-width 0 + border-box change).

--ki-badge-sm-radius.description: dimension used by the badge component for sm radius (MarsUI Tag silhouette is an 8px rounded rect — Radius/component/radius_sm — never a pill).

--ki-badge-success-bg.description: color used by the badge component for success background (MarsUI Surface/success_base_em_alpha: tone-500 at 12% light — the tint composites over any surface and the dark alias adapts automatically).

--ki-badge-success-border.description: color used by the badge component for success border.

--ki-badge-success-fg.description: color used by the badge component for success foreground.

--ki-badge-warning-bg.description: color used by the badge component for warning background (MarsUI Surface/warning_base_em_alpha: tone-500 at 12% light — the tint composites over any surface and the dark alias adapts automatically).

--ki-badge-warning-border.description: color used by the badge component for warning border.

--ki-badge-warning-fg.description: color used by the badge component for warning foreground.

--ki-badge-xs-font-size.description: dimension used by the badge component for xs font size (Tag 10106:4651 xs). Figma draws caption_1, 10px; caption_2, 12px, is the smallest text the library ships (spec 050 D7).

--ki-badge-xs-height.description: dimension used by the badge component for xs height (Tag 10106:4651 xs: 20px).

--ki-badge-xs-line-height.description: dimension used by the badge component for xs line height (caption_2 16px, the same height as caption_1).

--ki-badge-xs-padding-inline.description: dimension used by the badge component for xs padding inline (Tag 10106:4651 xs: Space/xs plus the Text_wrap Space/xxs, 6px).

--ki-badge-xs-radius.description: dimension used by the badge component for xs radius (Tag 10106:4651 xs binds Radius/small-component/xs).

--ki-effect-component-secondary-default-.description: MarsUI Component_effect/secondary_default: drop 0/2/1.5/-0.5 plus inner White/3 0/2/3. Pair with --ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter.

--ki-outline-secondary-button-bottom.description: semantic color for outline secondary button bottom.
